description: TOP ROW reference top-left ELDER, a mature gray BADGER-like raccoon masked elder with cream muzzle/cheek patches, round ears, silver hair, blue ceremonial robe gold trim and gold star embroidery. Bottom row reference top-second BODUM, broad middle-aged brown bear-like rounded animal with cream muzzle, mustard coat, olive long scarf, dark vest. Both preserve reference visual identity, no basket/cane in portraits.

TOP ROW reference top-third WORKSHOP, middle-aged charcoal MOLE mechanic, distinctive pink wide nose, small round ears, brass round spectacles perched nose, cream shirt sleeves and olive workshop apron. Bottom row reference top-fourth TORI white RABBIT, slender young adult, tall asymmetrical pink-lined ears, cream short rabbit muzzle, dark emerald jacket, cream shirt, mustard collar/strap and tan satchel shoulder strap. No giant teeth.

TOP ROW reference bottom-left BORI adult very broad muscular brown BEAR carpenter, cream muzzle, dark eyebrows, rust-orange rolled sleeve shirt, olive overalls brass straps. Bottom row reference bottom-second YEONI adult elegant orange FOX seamstress, pointed large fox ears and narrow cream fox muzzle, cream blouse, teal neck ribbon, beige apron, plum dress. Preserve different adult bodybuilds.

TOP ROW reference bottom-third KONGI young golden puppy child/teen with long floppy ears, cream muzzle, expressive gentle eyes, teal jacket and red scarf, brown backpack straps. Bottom row reference bottom-fourth KKWAK adult yellow DUCK with orange duckbill and tufted head, olive striped sweater, navy scarf, tan satchel strap. Bill closed neatly, both eyes visible.

Top row reference board TOP LEFT: LIBRARIAN mature gray CAT woman, cream muzzle, triangular feline ears, tiny gold glasses, navy cardigan, white collar green brooch, forest-green dress. Bottom row TOP SECOND: OWLGP elderly brown OWL grandfather with cream facial disk, large thoughtful eyes behind brass round spectacles, brown plaid cape coat with star brooch, red scarf, dark waistcoat gold watchchain. His small black owl beak never looks like mammal nose.

Top row board TOP THIRD: TEACHER warm mature brown BEAR male, cream muzzle round bear ears, small brass round spectacles, white collared shirt and burgundy knitted sweater vest. Bottom row TOP FOURTH: NERO adult gray LYNX male with triangular BLACK-TUFTED ears and cream muzzle, narrow mature cheeks, navy dark cloak clasped by gold brooch, charcoal suit beneath. Expressive eyes but sober restrained moods.

Top row board BOTTOM LEFT: SEOL tall elegant adult white CRANE bird, small red crown accent, white head, long straight black crane bill rendered front facing/slight15degree so BOTH eyes face player, pale blue scarf and navy ceremonial robe with gold crescent trim. Bottom row BOTTOM SECOND: PPUL mature white RAM/GOAT official, large symmetrical coiled brown horns, short white goatee, gold round spectacles, navy gold-trim coat and burgundy waistcoat gold chain.

Top row board BOTTOM THIRD: TOK adult brown MOLE clocksmith, broad pink pointed snout, small rounded ears, brass goggles atop forehead, teal rolled-sleeve shirt, tan work apron leather straps. Bottom row BOTTOM FOURTH: SLING adult orange-brown WEASEL mail carrier, long slim cream muzzle, SMALL rounded weasel ears (reference silhouette exaggerated triangular ears must soften, he is NOT fox), emerald postman's cap gold badge and coat, white shirt burgundy tie, tan shoulder mailbag strap. BOTH species maintain mature individual faces.

Bottom row TOP SECOND: TTADAK adult WOODPECKER male carpenter, large pointed RED swept crest, white cheek patches, dark charcoal beak (shortened naturally by front perspective), green shirt and yellow ochre work vest. Bird face beak anatomically front-centered, both eyes face player.

Bird bill gold neatly closed/relaxed; both eyes look player. Bottom row TOP FOURTH: MUNGCHI adult young male PANDA, black rounded ears and panda BLACK patches around eyes with cream head, burgundy beret and waistcoat, navy long coat, white shirt collar and gold pendant. Not squirrel, no squirrel face, no tail visible in bust.

Top row board BOTTOM LEFT: MADAM mature dignified female PANDA private warehouse owner, round black ears and clear panda eye patches, black Victorian dress, white lacy collar, pearl choker and gold amber brooch, white gloves. Broad mature woman proportions and calm eyes. Bottom row BOTTOM SECOND: SILUK adult lean brown WEASEL hauler with long narrow cream muzzle SMALL ears, gray flatcap, red neckerchief, olive shirt dark brown work vest, mature long narrow face. No squirrel features.

Top row board BOTTOM THIRD: MUSOE elderly broad GRAY BEAR grandfather, small round ears gray cream muzzle, forehead brass goggles, mustard scarf and navy doublebreasted coat with gold buttons; heavier brow elderly but appealing. Bottom row BOTTOM FOURTH: SOMI female child FLYING SQUIRREL, small rounded ears and pink bow, warm tan fur cream muzzle, fluffy forehead bangs, red short cape/scarf, cream tunic and green dress, brown crossbody satchel strap. She is the child, grandfather is much more mature. Both front-facing.

Top row board TOP LEFT: SEORI middleaged gray GOAT inspector male, brown swept-back curved horns, gray face/cream muzzle, small beard, dark fedora, gray trenchcoat over charcoal suit, white shirt black tie. Clear distinctive species, both heads and gaze front.

Friendly mature eyes, not a child duck. Bottom row TOP FOURTH: EUNHO tall elegant adult WHITE FOX merchant male, tall sharply pointed ears, narrow cream pointed muzzle, round black spectacles, navy tailored frockcoat and waistcoat with brass buttons, emerald green cravat. Calm confident adult gaze. Both eyes look viewer.

Top row board BOTTOM LEFT: GUSEUL young adult gray RACCOON apprentice, dark mask across eyes, short triangular-rounded raccoon ears, cream muzzle, blue rolled-sleeve work shirt, green apron with tan leather shoulder straps. Bottom row BOTTOM SECOND: BADOOK adult DALMATIAN DOG nightwatchman, white face with distinctive irregular black spots, long floppy spotted ears, navy patrol cap gold badge, navy cape gold trim and gold cravat. Closed canine smile, no exaggerated teeth, both look at viewer.

ONLY ONE CHARACTER: reference board BOTTOM THIRD LAMPLIGHTER mature brown LOP-EARED RABBIT male, VERY LONG drooping ears to shoulders, cream short rabbit muzzle, olive workcoat and orange scarf, tan crossbody tool-satchel strap. NO buckteeth. Make FOUR waist-up poses on TOP ROW ONLY following neutral/thinking/distressed/expressive. Entire bottom row EMPTY transparent. Four portraits only, do not draw any second character.
